💡 severity: SUGGESTION —
💡 **SUGGESTION: the soft-window warning can state a condition that is false**

The regime triggers when `overhead + newestUserTurn >= window − reserve` (`windowBelowFixedOverhead`, soft_window.dart:29) — not when the window is below the overhead. Yet the once-per-session warning hard-codes "context window N **is below the fixed request overhead** ≈M tokens". When a large newest user turn (not the overhead) is what crossed the trigger — M < N — the warning names a condition that does not hold, on the PR whose own contract is honest numbers (gh-2411 "honest logs", gh-2423 C3 "honest notices"; docs/compaction.md quotes this exact text).

Suggested shape: report what actually holds, e.g.

```
warning: context window 25000 cannot take a trim below its trigger — fixed
request overhead ≈21000 + the newest user turn ≈6000 already reach it
(estimated from the system prompt, tool schemas and the turn); raising the
window or disabling tools is the only fix; automatic compaction is skipped
while the context stays under the window
```

or at minimum hedge the overhead clause ("is at/below the fixed request overhead plus the newest user turn"). The diagnostic line above it (`soft window sid=… overhead≈…`) is already accurate — this is only the user-facing wording.
